# ElectronicWarfareNeuromorphic

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The application of neuromorphic hardware and algorithms to electronic warfare tasks such as spectrum sensing, jamming detection, and adaptive countermeasures. Provides a novel pathway for adaptive, real-time RF threat response within network-centric neuromorphic systems, enhancing resilience in contested environments.
